lines.text: If we're going to recruit more cheerleaders, do we need to hold auditions?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: It was an audition that got me my spot on the team.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That wasn't long ago though, and we're already holding another one for a new member?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'm a bit concerned.
What about?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Like Clay was saying, it was only a few months ago that we held auditions.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: She was the only participant.
How come?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: There was negative press surrounding the team,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: and our reputation hit rock bottom.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Pretty soon after that, all the other team members left.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Anyone can see that Rewind is on a downhill trajectory.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: If it were me, I certainly wouldn't be interested in joining us.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I don't agree at all! I really wanted to join Rewind.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Although it was a bit of a bummer getting turned down at every audition.
How did you end up getting picked this time?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Cause luckily for me, there were no other applicants.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: That's not why you got picked.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: You've got a natural knack for showmanship.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: You saw it yourself, Coach.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Crowds are like putty in Clay's hands.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: She definitely has the ability.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: At the time, other team members were responsible for vetting applications, I was far removed from that process.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I only participated as a judge in the final audition, so I didn't even know that Clay had applied every time.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe, well, at any rate, I'm just happy that I ended up in Rewind.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: So long as you don't give up, opportunities will always come your way.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: And now that I've joined the team I've been dreaming of, I'll do whatever it takes to get Rewind back on top.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: ... Clay.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: So let's stop sitting around feeling sorry for ourselves, and get outta this rut!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: ... Yes, all right. Let's do it.
I'll also do whatever I can to help.
I'm the coach, after all.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thank you, Coach.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: So, where should we start?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Arranging an open audition would take a lot of time.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I think it might be better if we contact people directly.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: ... Hmm.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: But I don't really know anyone.
Leave that to me.
I've got connections for days.
I have a few Nikkes in mind.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Ha, I knew it.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I've heard about how you're quite the social butterfly, Coach.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Looks like there's substance to those rumors.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Already?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Wow, you're amazing, Coach!
Although I'm projecting the utmost confidence,
in actuality, I have no clue as to who I should approach.
Before I consider anyone for casting, are there any must-have qualifications a cheerleader should possess?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: First and foremost, they should have commendable stamina.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We don't want anyone getting tired and giving up whenever things get tough.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Secondly,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: while they don't have to be an incredible dancer, they at least have to be flexible.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thirdly,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: it's imperative that they have courage.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: A lot of maneuvers we do involve tumbling and being airborne.
What about you, Clay?

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I agree with what Bay said.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Actually, I've kind of got two left feet and can have a hard time following a beat,

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: but I never give up, and I never get tired. I'm also pretty courageous, if I do say so myself.
All right, I understand.
Considering all the information relayed to me by Bay and Clay, the Nikkes I want to recommend are:
Blanc and Noir.
Naga and Tia.
Blanc and Noir might make for solid cheerleaders.
Since they perform on stage regularly, they're both physically nimble and have stamina.
Yes, let's go with them.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Huh? Ch-cheerleaders?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Huh...? Ch-cheerleaders...?
Yes. I thought you would be good at it.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Please, we're begging you.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You'd be doing us a huge favor.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: It's definitely fun to think about.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: What do you think, Noir?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I'm not so sure I'm confident enough to be a cheerleader...

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: It might be embarrassing dancing in front of a lot of people.
What? That's exactly what you do now.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: It's not the same.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Don't worry about the cheerleading.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'll hold your hand and show you all the steps.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Are you really interested in this, Blanc?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Totally! As long as you're okay with it, that is.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: It'll be fun to learn something new,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: and cheering other people on sounds like a great time. Good vibes all around!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: If you're that dead set on it... then I'll do it too.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Are you really going to help?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Sure... I'll do what I can.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: It still makes me a bit self-conscious to think of everyone looking at me dancing though...

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Hehe, don't you worry. Leave all that to me.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Blanc and I will take the lion's share of the attention.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Oh man, I'm so pumped!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: So when is the competition?
Two weeks from now.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Hold on...

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Blanc, that's...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Oh no, you're right!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: What? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: There's a big event being held at Coin Rush in two weeks' time.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: We're supposed to be practicing for that, so I don't think we'll be able to help after all.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We can't even steal you for a moment?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Sorry, but we really have to focus all of our attention on our training...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: It's our own fault for not asking about the timing up front. Again, so sorry!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: No, there's no need to apologize.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: What a bummer.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: If you ever need any more people in the future, be sure to hit us up, and we'll be down!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: R-right!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Cheerleading?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: We tried it at last year's school festival.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Yeah, I remember it being a lot of fun.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You were really good at it!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: So were you.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I dunno, I found all the aerial stuff a bit challenging.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I felt like I was a massive anchor.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I was such a klutz back then.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You don't have to worry about that!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I've got two left feet myself. All the jumping around is tough for me as well.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hmmm...
Tia eyeballs Clay.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You and I are kind of similar, actually.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: That's why I'm the one in charge of hyping up the crowd.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I stick to the front of the stage and engage with the audience.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You can do that with me.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hmm... that might be fun.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What do you think, Naga?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: If you're up for it, then I'm game.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Pretty please?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'm worried though. What if we're no good at it?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: You don't need to worry about that.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I'll hold your hand and show you all the steps.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Well, if you say so... maybe we can give it a try...

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You're a lifesaver!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: When is the competition?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Two weeks from now.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Oh dear, I don't think that'll work then.
Why? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: That's when we have exams.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: We've got some serious cramming to do.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Darn, why did it have to take place during exams?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: What a bummer.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: ... Well, it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: We'll be sure to go and watch you during the competition.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Yeah, we'll be in your corner for sure!

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: ... Thanks.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: I knew from the start that this wouldn't be easy,

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: but this is really tough going.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We're at a total impasse.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: And those two seemed like they'd be such a good fit.
It's too early to give up now.
Let's find someone else.
The next Nikke I think we can go to is:
Diesel.
Emma.
Diesel once trained to be a pop star, so she might not be a bad choice.
It won't be a problem that she can't sing either,
since singing doesn't come into play with cheerleading.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Oh my, a cheerleader?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hehe, sounds fun.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Do we get to sing while we do it?

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Singing? Well, if you'd like to...
No. Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Darn, that's too bad.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: How does cheerleading work anyway? Does it go like this?
*Tap taptap*
*Clap clap*
Diesel stomps her feet and claps her hands above her head.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Um, more or less, but...
Diesel's rhythm is somehow off.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: One, two. One, two.
Bay demonstrates a simple cheerleading routine to Diesel while shaking her pompoms up and down.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: Usually you want your movements to be rhythmic, like this.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Ah, gotcha.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: One two... one two...
Diesel follows Bay, but her footwork is always one beat behind the chant.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: You guys...

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: I think she's got an even worse sense of rhythm than me.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: One two... one two...

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: We can't have two people without rhythm on the team.
It seems Diesel won't work out.
As I conjure up the image of Emma as a cheerleader,
I feel she might end up being quite popular.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I thought you were dead.
Where's Emma?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: How should I know?
... I see.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Why are you still here?
Eunhwa, are you interested in cheerleading by any chance?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I should have known you'd come here to spout off nonsense.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Get lost.
No, wait...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: This conversation is over.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: Coach, this girl is kinda scary... Let's just go.
*Whoooosh*
We continue to wander to various other places,
but are unable to find any suitable candidates amongst the Nikkes.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: This is proving to be a real challenge.

lines.speaker: bay
lines.text: We can't exactly force anyone to work with us, either.

lines.speaker: clay
lines.text: How about you, Coach? Do you think you could do it?
There has to be at least one person out there who would make a decent cheerleader.
Someone who is flexible, energetic, and has hair that matches the pompoms...

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Oh, hi Commander!
Poli!!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: ... Huh?
